description: Check whether marketing claims and calls to action are specific enough to believe. It catches the vague superlative, like "the best" or "#1", that readers discount on sight. It catches promises with no proof behind them and results with no mechanism, and it flags the generic buttons everyone uses, like "Learn more" and "Get started". Then it says how to fix each one. It covers claims like "results in days", "trusted by thousands" or "the #1 tool", and any button text. For a headline, it checks the claim only, not whether the headline does its job in its spot.

context.description: For a claim in the body, the paragraph around it, so a mechanism named nearby still counts.

text.description: The claim or the button text, exactly as written.

type.description: headline, cta (a button or call to action) or body_claim (a claim inside the copy).

name: check_marketing_claims
title: Check marketing claims and CTAs
